verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs say its connectors sync to a data warehouse or data lake, including managed lakes in open table formats, and it has a dedicated supported-destinations page. The official MCP tooling can copy existing connections to a new destination with configs and schemas intact, which covers the 'without changing pipelines' part. Community users confirm loading into Snowflake and BigQuery. Missing for 10: explicit evidence naming Databricks, Postgres and object storage as destinations, the destinations page content beyond its title, and independent hands-on confirmation of moving pipelines between destinations.
